blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge.
It is therefore critical to verify each skill’s reusability : whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled.
Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised.
To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox , a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel.
A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill.
The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library.
Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency.
Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them. [CODE]

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Self-evolving agents seek to improve their capabilities by learning from their own experiences ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
They distill task-solving experience into skills ( Anthropic, 2025 ) that provide procedural guidance and store them in a library for future reuse ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2026b ) .
However, distilled skills do not always guarantee the performance improvement ( Li et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Gautam et al., 2026 ) .
Because task-solving experience contains redundant exploration, mistakes, and task-specific details, distillation may yield incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge ( Ni et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ) .
Once stored and retrieved, such skills can repeatedly interfere with the agent’s behavior ( Dong et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) .
Self-evolving agents therefore need to verify each skill’s reusability : whether the guidance remains useful when applied beyond the source experience.
blocks.zh:
自发的代理人通过学习自己的经验来提高自身的能力(高等等,2026;杨等,2026.
他们将解决任务的经验提炼成提供程序指导的技能(Anthropic,2025年),并将其储存在图书馆供今后再利用(Wang等人,2023年;Ouyang等人,2026年b).
然而,分馏出的技能并不总是能保证性能的提高(Li等,2026;Han等,2026;Gautam等,2026.).
由于任务解决经验包含冗余的探索,错误,以及特定任务的细节,蒸馏可能会产生不正确的程序或不可转让的知识(Ni等,2026;Ma等,2026;Xiong等,2026.).
一旦存储并取回,这种技能会再三干扰代理商的行为(董等,2026;梁等,2026).
因此,自我发展代理人需要验证每种技能的可重复性: 指南是否在源头经验之外继续有用。

blocks.en:
Such verification requires execution evidence from a scenario that is both skill-relevant and novel.
That is, the agent should actually encounter the situation the skill addresses in a new environment, so that the evidence reveals whether the guidance improves its behavior beyond the source experience.
Because different skills address different situations, the scenario that provides this evidence is inherently skill-specific.
However, existing approaches ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ) verify skills against a static pool of tasks that already exists, and merely select from it.
Replaying the source task likely exposes the targeted situation, but only in the context the skill was distilled from, so the evidence is relevant but not novel ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
Evaluating the skill on other existing tasks introduces new contexts, but since these tasks are defined independently of the skill, they need not expose the targeted situation.
blocks.zh:
这种核查需要从既与技能相关又具有新意的情景中提供执行证据。
也就是说,代理商在新的环境中应该实际遇到技能地址的情况,这样证据就揭示出指导是否超越了源头经验来改善其行为.
由于不同的技能处理不同的情况,提供这种证据的情景本质上是技能特有的。
然而,现有办法(Wang等人,2025a; 张等, 2026; 欧阳等, 2026a) 对照已经存在的一系列静态任务验证技能, 仅从中选择.
重放源头任务可能暴露目标状况,但只有在背景中才对技能进行提炼,因此证据是相关的,但并不新鲜(Chen等,2026a; 刘等, 2026).
评估其他现有任务的技能带来了新的背景,但由于这些任务是独立于技能界定的,因此不需要暴露目标状况。

blocks.en:
Verification should therefore shift from selecting existing tasks, to constructing the task and environment around the target skill, on demand.
To this end, we propose SkillSandbox , a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and environment where the target situation arises in a context different from the source experience to verify skills.
Each synthesized task and its configured environment form a verification scenario, which serves as a controlled test of that skill. SkillSandbox consists of a Proposer , a Builder , and a Verifier , which design, construct, and evaluate this test, respectively.
(i) The Proposer specifies the conditions that reproduce this situation and the modifications that distinguish the scenario from the source experience.
(ii) The Builder realizes this specification as an executable task and its configured environment.
(iii) The Verifier compares executions in the scenario with and without the skill and measures the effect of the skill in terms of executability, task success, and efficiency.
Consequently, a reusable skill yields a positive effect across its scenarios and is admitted to the library, whereas a skill that is incorrect, overly specific, or not actionable yields no benefit or degrades execution and is rejected.
blocks.zh:
因此,核查应当从选择现有任务转变为根据需要围绕目标技能构建任务和环境。
为此,我们提出SkillSandbox,这个框架动态地综合了一个任务和环境,在与源经验不同的背景中出现目标情况,以验证技能.
每项综合任务及其所配置的环境构成了一种核查设想,作为对这种技能的一种有控制的测试。 SkillSandbox由投标人、构建人和验证人组成,分别设计、构建和评价这一测试。
(一) 投标人具体规定了复制这种情况的条件,以及将情景与来源经验区分开来的修改。
(二)构建者将这一规格视为可执行的任务及其配置的环境.
(三) 核查人将情景下的处决与或不具有技能和衡量技能在可执行性、任务成功和效率方面的效果进行比较。
因此,可重复使用的技能在各种情况下产生积极效果并被图书馆所接受,而不正确、过于具体或不起作用的技能则不会产生任何好处或贬低执行,因此遭到拒绝。

blocks.en:
We evaluate SkillSandbox on ALFWorld and WebShop by comparing the library of verified skills with libraries constructed by baseline methods, which either accumulate every generated skill or continually update the library as experience accumulates.
Across three models, the verified library achieves the highest success rate with the fewest steps on both benchmarks.
Further analyses show that the performance gains originate from the synthesized scenarios, as verification on source tasks or randomly selected tasks yields smaller gains and the gap widens on task types unseen in the source experience.
In addition, the verification predicts the helpful and harmful effects of individual skills on held-out tasks.
Each criterion also proves necessary, as the full Verifier outperforms variants that omit executability or efficiency.
blocks.zh:
我们评价ALFWorld和WebShop上的SkillSandbox,方法是将经核实的技能库与基线方法构建的图书馆进行比较,这些图书馆要么积累所有产生的技能,要么随着经验积累不断更新图书馆。
在三种模式中,经核实的图书馆取得了最高的成功率,在这两个基准上的步骤最少。
进一步的分析表明,业绩收益源于综合情景,因为对源任务或随机选择的任务的核查产生的收益较小,对源经验所未见的任务类型的差距也扩大。
此外,核查还预测个人技能对被搁置任务产生的有益和有害影响。
每项标准也证明都是必要的,因为完全验证者超越了省去可执行性或效率的变体。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We identify that skill verification should shift from selecting existing tasks to constructing the task and environment around the target skill on demand. • We propose SkillSandbox , which synthesizes a task and environment that expose the situation needed to verify the skill. Its Proposer and Builder generate scenarios, and Verifier measures the reusability of skill and determines whether to keep or reject it. • Our experiment confirms that the skill library verified by SkillSandbox significantly improves downstream performance. Extensive analyses validate the effect of SkillSandbox and show that the synthesized scenarios provide a reliable verification environment.

blocks.en: 2 Preliminary Analyses: Skill-Specific Evidence Is Sparse in Existing Experience
blocks.zh: 2 初步分析:特定技能证据是现有经验的分部分

blocks.en:
We first ask whether the scenario synthesis is actually necessary to verify skills.
Can existing tasks provide the evidence needed for verification?
To answer this question, we examine alternatives to scenario synthesis and evaluate whether either one reliably provides the skill-specific evidence. • Question I: Do semantically similar tasks expose the skill-relevant situation? • Question II: How sparse are skill-relevant situations in downstream experience?
blocks.zh:
我们首先要问,情景综合是否是核实技能的实际必要。
现有任务能否提供核查所需的证据?
为了回答这个问题,我们研究了情景综合的替代方法,并评估其中之一是否可靠地提供了具体技能的证据。 • 问题一:相似的任务是否揭示与技能有关的情况? • 问题二:下游经验中与技能有关的情况如何稀少?

blocks.en: Question I: Do semantically similar tasks expose the skill-relevant situation?
blocks.zh: 问题一:相似的任务是否揭示出与技能有关的情况?

blocks.en: Question II: How sparse are skill-relevant situations in downstream experience?
blocks.zh: 问题 二:与技能有关的情况在下游经验中是多么稀少?

blocks.en: 2.1 Question I: Do semantically similar tasks expose the skill-relevant situation?
blocks.zh: 2.1 问题一:相似的任务是否揭示出与技能有关的情况?

blocks.en: Table 1: Mean skill-relevant tasks out of 10 retrieved tasks. N N : candidate task count.
blocks.zh: 表1:10项检索任务中与技能相关的平均任务。 N N: 候选任务计数.

blocks.en:
We examine whether semantic similarity can identify existing tasks that expose the skill-relevant situation.
We use 50 skills per benchmark, 140 held-out tasks in ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) and nested pools of 200, 300, and 500 tasks in WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022a ) , keeping the same 50 skills across pool sizes.
For each skill, we select the 10 held-out tasks whose instructions are most similar to the skill text.
The agent executes each selected task with the target skill provided, and an LLM judge determines from the trajectory whether execution encounters the skill-relevant situation.
blocks.zh:
我们研究语义上的相似性是否能够确定暴露出与技能有关情况的现有任务。
我们使用每个基准的50个技能,在ALFWorld(Shridhar等,2020年)的140个被搁置的任务,以及WebShop(姚等,2022a)的200个、300个和500个被巢集的任务,在池子大小上保持同样的50个技能。
对于每种技能,我们选择10个被搁置的任务,其指令与技能文本最为相近.
代理人以所提供的目标技能执行每个选定的任务,由LLM法官从轨迹中确定执行是否遇到与技能有关的情况.

blocks.en:
Instruction similarity does not reliably identify tasks that exercise the target skill. As shown in Table 1 , the skill-relevant situation is observed in only up to 6.66 out of 10 selected tasks per skill across the settings.
Even expanding the candidate pool from 200 to 500 tasks yields only marginal gains in skill-relevant coverage among the top-10 retrieved tasks.
The main reason to this is that semantic similarity is measured at the task level, whereas skill relevance depends on what occurs during execution.
Tasks with similar instructions can still induce different states, interactions, and intermediate decisions, and therefore need not expose the same skill-relevant situation.
Consequently, task-level similarity does not reliably provide the execution evidence required for skill verification.
blocks.zh:
指令的相似性无法可靠地识别那些能发挥目标技能的任务. 如表1所示,在各种情况下,每10项选定任务中只有6.66项与技能有关的情况。
即使将候选人才库从200个增加到500个任务,在10个获得最多任务中,在与技能有关的覆盖面方面也只取得微小的进展。
其主要原因是语义相似性是在任务一级衡量的,而技能相关性则取决于执行过程中发生的情况.
具有类似指示的任务仍然可以诱导不同的状态,互动和中间决定,因此不需要暴露出与技能相关的同样情况.
因此,任务一级的相似性无法可靠地提供技能核查所需的执行证据。

blocks.en: 2.2 Question II: How sparse are skill-relevant situations in downstream experience?
blocks.zh: 2.2 问 题 二:与技能有关的情况在下游经验中是多么稀少?

blocks.en: Figure 1: Percentage of skills used in (a) at least one task and (b) at least 5 tasks as downstream tasks are streamed and solved sequentially (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, WebShop). Mean of three runs of the same task stream; bands show one standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 图 1:由于下游任务流出并相继解决(Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite,WebShop),在(a)至少一项任务和(b)至少五项任务中使用的技能百分比. 同一任务流的三次运行平均值;波段显示一个标准偏差.

blocks.en:
A second alternative is to accumulate verification evidence from subsequent downstream experience ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ) .
We construct a library of 50 skills and stream 500 held-out tasks in a fixed random order, repeating each setting three times.
For each task, referenced skill IDs are recorded in rationale and counted.
We vary the number of skills accessible, with Top-3 and Top-5 Retrieval providing the top-3 or 5 skills retrieved per task, respectively, and Full Library all 50 skills on every task.
Figure 1 (a) reports the percentage of skills used in at least one task, and (b) reports the percentage used in at least 5 distinct tasks.
blocks.zh:
第二种办法是从随后的下游经验中积累核查证据(Zhang等,2026;Xiong等,2026;Ouyang等,2026a)。
我们以固定的随机顺序构建一个包含50个技能和500个被搁置任务的库,每设定三次重复一次。
每项任务的参考技能标识都记录在理由中并计算在内。
我们掌握的技能数量各有不同,Top-3和Top-5检索器分别提供每个任务检索到的Top-3或5个技能,Full Library所有50个每个任务的技能.
图1 (a) 报告至少一项任务所用技能的百分比;(b) 报告至少五项不同任务所用技能的百分比。

blocks.en:
Skill-relevant situations remain sparse as downstream experience accumulates. (a) shows that coverage grows slowly after 300 tasks. Executing 200 additional tasks raises the percentage of skills used at least once by only 4.7–6.7 percentage points.
After 500 tasks, only 68% of skills are used under Top-3 Retrieval, 83% under Top-5, and 70% under Full Library.
Thus, depending on the access setting, 17–32% of skills remain unexercised , which means that their effects on the agent’s behavior are never observed, leaving their reusability unverifiable.
More reliable verification benefits from repeated evidence across distinct tasks, yet such opportunities are even more sparse.
As shown in (b), only 44–55% of skills are used in at least 5 tasks.
Even after 500 tasks, 45–56% of the skills fail to accumulate five execution opportunities.
Overall, downstream experience leaves a substantial number of skills with insufficient evidence for verification.
blocks.zh:
随着下游经验的积累,与技能有关的情况仍然很少。 (a) 显示在300项任务之后,覆盖面增长缓慢。 执行200项额外任务,至少使用一次的技能百分比只提高了4.7-6.7个百分点。
在完成500个任务后,只有68%的技能用于Top-3检索,83%用于Top-5,70%用于Full Library.
因此,视准入环境而定,17-32%的技能仍未被使用,这意味着对代理行为的影响从未被观察到,使得其可重复性无法核实。
不同任务之间反复提出证据,有利于更可靠的核查,但这种机会却更加稀少。
如(b)所示,至少有5项工作只使用44-55%的技能。
即使完成了500个任务,45-56%的技能也无法积累5个执行机会.
总的来说,下游的经验使大量技能得不到足够的核实证据。

blocks.en:
Together, Questions I and II reveal complementary limitations of relying on existing tasks for verification.
Neither reliably provides the skill-specific evidence that verification needs.
We therefore construct verification scenarios that induce the target situation beyond its source experience.
blocks.zh:
问题加在一起 一和二揭示了依赖现有核查任务的互补性局限性。
两者都无法可靠地提供核查需要的具体技能证据。
因此,我们构筑了核查设想方案,在来源经验之外诱发目标局势。

blocks.zh: 图 2: 通过动态情景综合对技能核查的概述。

blocks.en:
A skill k = ( condition , principle ) k=(\texttt{condition},\texttt{principle}) is distilled from a source task x src x_{\mathrm{src}} and trajectory τ src \tau_{\mathrm{src}} .
The condition describes when the skill applies, and the principle provides knowledge or guidance for that situation.
Verification assesses the skill’s reusability , defined as its ability to guide executable behavior that improves task success or execution efficiency in new situations satisfying the condition .
We verify the skill’s reusability along three dimensions: 1. Executability: The principle can be executed through admissible actions in the environment when the condition is satisfied. 2. Utility: Applying the principle helps the agent achieve the task goal, improving task success relative to execution without the skill. 3. Efficiency: The principle enables the task completion with fewer actions than execution without the skill.

该条件说明了技能何时适用,该原则为这种情况提供了知识或指导。
核查评估技能的可续用性,其定义是其指导可执行行为的能力,在符合条件的新情况中提高任务成功或执行效率。
我们从三个方面验证技能的可重复性: 1. 可执行性: 这一原则可在满足条件后通过环境中的可受理行动予以执行。 2. 效用:应用这一原则有助于代理人实现任务目标,相对于没有技能的执行任务,提高任务的成功率. 3. 效率:该原则使完成任务的行动少于没有技能的执行。

blocks.en:
Evaluating these dimensions only on the source task x src x_{\mathrm{src}} does not establish reusability in new task contexts, while arbitrary tasks may not reproduce the situation described by the condition .
Verification scenarios must therefore be both skill-relevant and novel .
A scenario is skill-relevant when completing the task requires addressing the situation described by condition , in which the guidance in principle can be evaluated.
It is novel when the agent encounters a task context that differs from the source experience.

因此,核查设想必须既与技能相关又具有新意。
在完成任务时,一种情景与技能相关,需要处理条件描述的情况,其中原则上可以评估指导。
当代理遇到与源经验不同的任务背景时,这是新奇的.

To construct scenarios that are both skill-relevant and novel, we reproduce the situation described by the condition while reconstructing the new task context.
We jointly construct a task x δ x_{\delta} and configuration κ δ \kappa_{\delta} so that the condition holds during execution, while varying the details.
Execution in the resulting scenario tests whether the principle remains useful when the situation described by the condition occurs in a context different from the source experience.
Figure 2 illustrates this synthesis process.
In SkillSandbox , the Proposer specifies how to reproduce the condition in a new context, and the Builder constructs the scenario according to this specification.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We first present the experimental setup (Section 4.1 ) and main results (Section 4.2 ).
We compare SkillSandbox with baselines that construct skill libraries with or without verification.
To examine how effectively each method retains reusable skills, we build a library using each method and evaluate it on the same held-out tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们首先介绍试验设置(第4.1节)和主要结果(第4.2节)。
我们比较了SkillSandbox与构建技能库的基线,无论是否经过核实。
为了审查每种方法如何有效地保留可重复使用的技能,我们利用每种方法建立了一个图书馆,并根据同样的搁置任务对其进行评价。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate on ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022a ) .
ALFWorld provides six household task types, and WebShop requires agents to find and purchase products that satisfy user instructions.
blocks.zh:
我们评价ALFWorld(Shridhar等,2020年)和WebShop(姚等,2022a.).
ALFWorld提供6个家庭任务类型,WebShop要求代理商寻找并购买满足用户指令的产品.

blocks.en:
We report success rate (SR, %) on both benchmarks, average task score (Score, 0–100) on WebShop, and average steps across all episodes.
To characterize how a skill library changes individual task outcomes beyond SR, we additionally report Recovery ( Rec. ) and Regression ( Reg. ) relative to the run without skill library of the same model. Recovery is the percentage of all held-out tasks that fail without skills but succeed with the library, whereas Regression is the percentage that succeed without skills but fail with the library.
blocks.zh:
我们报告两个基准的成功率(SR,%),WebShop的平均任务分数(Score,0–100),以及所有各集的平均步骤。
为了描述一个技能库如何改变超越SR的单个任务结果,我们额外报告了与同一模式的无技能库运行相比的恢复(Rec.)和后退(Reg.). 恢复是所有被搁置任务中没有技能但成功使用图书馆的百分比,而倒退则是没有技能但失败使用图书馆的百分比。

blocks.en:
No Skill executes tasks without a skill library. Vanilla Skill retains all skills generated with the distillation prompt from SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) .
We additionally compare with ReasoningBank ( Ouyang et al., 2026b ) and MemP ( Fang et al., 2026b ) , as well as execution-based library curation methods including ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and SkillOS ( Ouyang et al., 2026a ) .
ExpeL, ACE, and SkillOS admit skills using execution feedback: ExpeL extracts insights from repeated attempts at the source task, whereas ACE and SkillOS update the library from subsequent tasks that are selected independently of any skill.
Detailed descriptions of each baseline are provided in Appendix A . SkillSandbox retains only the skills from Vanilla Skill that are verified as Keep.

没有技能库就无法执行任务 。 香草 Skill保留了由SkillRL(Xia等人,2026年)所催生出的所有技能.
我们还与ReasoningBank(Oyang等,2026b)和MemP(Fang等,2026b)进行了比较,并采用了基于执行的图书馆校正方法,包括ExpeL(赵等,2024),ACE(张等,2026)和SkillOS(Oyang等,2026a).
ExpeL, ACE, 和 SkillOS 使用执行反馈承认技能 : ExpeL从源任务中反复尝试中取出洞见,而ACE和SkillOS则从后续任务中不依赖任何技能选择来更新库.
附录A详细介绍了每个基准。 SkillSandbox只保留了从Vanilla Skill中被验证为Keep的技能.

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , and Qwen3.5-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as executors within the ReAct framework ( Yao et al., 2022b ) .
The same model is used for execution and skill generation, and our scenario synthesis and verification also use the same model.
All baselines use the same 100 source tasks to execute and generate skills, and each library is frozen before held-out evaluation.
We evaluate on 140 tasks from the official ALFWorld test sets and 500 tasks from the official WebShop test sets, retrieving the top-3 skills for each task (Appendix ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 4.1 , libraries admitted without our verification achieve lower SR than No Skill in most settings.
This degradation is often accompanied by an increase in average steps, which means that the agent inefficiently spends more steps on redundant exploration yet solves fewer tasks.
These results suggest that distilled skills can act as noise, impairing both task success and execution efficiency.
Verifying their reusability before admission is therefore important for filtering out non-reusable skills.
blocks.zh:
如表4.1所示,未经我们核实而录取的图书馆在大多数情况下的SR比没有技能要低。
这种退化往往伴随着平均步数的增加,这意味着该剂在多余的勘探上花费更多的步数效率低下,却能解决较少的任务.
这些结果表明,被蒸馏出的技能可起噪声作用,既会损害任务的成功,也会损害执行效率.
因此,在录取之前核实他们的再使用性对于筛选出无法再使用的技能十分重要。

blocks.en:
SkillSandbox consistently outperforms execution-based curation methods (ExpeL, ACE, and SkillOS) across all models and benchmarks, improving SR over the strongest of these baselines by up to 21.4%p.
These results suggest that using execution feedback alone does not guarantee effective skill verification.
ExpeL obtains evidence from repeated executions of the source task, whereas ACE and SkillOS use subsequent task stream. SkillSandbox instead acquires the verification evidence from execution on the skill-specific scenarios.
Section 5.1 validates the contribution of scenario synthesis by comparing with other execution-based evidence under the same rollout budget.
blocks.zh:
SkillSandbox 在所有模型和基准中,执行方法(ExpeL, ACE, 和 SkillOS)的效绩始终超过执行方法,使SR比这些基准中最强的提高21.4% p.
这些结果表明,仅利用执行反馈并不能保证有效的技能核查。
ExpeL通过重复执行源任务获得证据,而ACE和SkillOS则使用后续任务流. SkillSandbox则从针对技能具体情况的处决中获得核查证据。
第5.1节通过比较同一推出预算下的其他基于执行的证据来验证情景综合的贡献。

blocks.en:
On ALFWorld with Gemini, MemP and SkillSandbox achieve the same Recovery , but SkillSandbox has approximately 37% lower Regression .
Consequently, MemP reduces SR relative to No Skill, whereas SkillSandbox improves it.
Reliable verification should therefore both help the agent solve previously failed tasks and preserve success on tasks it already solves.
blocks.zh:
在与双子座的ALFWorld上,MemP和SkillSandbox实现了相同的恢复,但SkillSandbox的回转率大约为37%.
因此,与无技能相比,MemP减少了SR,而SkillSandbox则改进了它.
因此,可靠的核查应既能帮助代理人解决以前失败的任务,又能维持它已经解决的任务的成功。

blocks.en:
Compared with the unverified Vanilla Skill library, verification increases Recovery by up to 9.2%p and reduces or maintains Regression across all settings.
The resulting library achieves the lowest Regression across all settings and the highest Recovery in all but one setting.
It is the only library with higher Recovery than Regression in every setting, consistently improving SR over No Skill.
Together, these results show that verification selects an effective subset of the original library.
blocks.zh:
与未经验证的"香草技能"库相比,校验增加 恢复最高为9.2%p,并减少或保持所有设置的后退。
由此形成的库实现所有设置中最低回转,除一个设置外,所有设置中最高回转.
它是唯一一个在每一环境下恢复率高于回归率的图书馆,持续改善性健康和生殖健康,而不是技能。
这些结果共同表明,校验会选择原始库中的有效子集.

blocks.en:
On ALFWorld, Gemini and Qwen(27B) already solve most held-out tasks without skills, which leaves little room for verification to improve SR, yet SkillSandbox is the only library that does.
On WebShop, where the executors solve far fewer tasks on their own, the verified library adds more than 10%p with lower Regression .
Verification selects from the original library rather than improving the skills themselves, so it can add only what that library contains.
Indeed, far fewer of the ALFWorld skills are helpful on held-out tasks (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在ALFWorld上,双子座和Quen(27B)已经解决了大多数没有技能被搁置的任务,这为改进SR留下了很小的核查空间,然而SkillSandbox是唯一一个能够完成的库.
在 WebShop 上,执行者自己解决的任务要少得多,经过验证的库会增加超过 10% p 并带有更低的回转.
校验从原始的库中选择,而不是提高技能本身,因此只能添加该库包含的内容.
事实上,在ALFWorld帮助完成被搁置的任务方面,技能要少得多(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en:
The main experiments show that the verified library improves downstream performance.
We now examine which components of our verification framework contribute to this improvement and whether it reflects accurate assessment of skill reusability through the following research questions: • RQ1: Does scenario synthesis improve the effectiveness of verification? • RQ2: Does verification predict skill reusability? • RQ3: Does reliable skill verification require a stronger model? • RQ4: What do the synthesized scenarios reveal about skill reusability?
blocks.zh:
主要实验显示,已核实的图书馆改善了下游的性能.
我们现在审查核查框架的哪些组成部分有助于这种改进,以及它是否通过下列研究问题反映了对技能可重复性的准确评估: RQ1:情景综合是否提高了核查的有效性? • RQ2:核查是否预测技能的可重复性? • RQ3:可靠的技能核查是否需要更强有力的模式? • RQ4:综合情景显示技能可重复性是什么?

blocks.en: 5.1 RQ1: Does scenario synthesis improve the effectiveness of verification?
blocks.zh: 5.1 RQ1:情景综合是否提高了核查的有效性?

blocks.en:
To evaluate the contribution of synthesized scenarios, we compare verification evidence generated from synthesized scenarios, source tasks, and randomly selected tasks.
We use Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on both benchmarks and keep the Verifier and rollout budget fixed, varying only the tasks on which evidence is generated.
Under this budget, each skill is verified on 5 synthesized scenarios, 5 executions of its source task, or 5 random tasks.
We evaluate verification accuracy against each skill’s effectiveness on held-out tasks, measured through paired executions with and without the skill (Appendix B ).
A skill is labeled helpful if it increases the success rate and harmful if it decreases.
blocks.zh:
为了评价综合情景的贡献,我们比较了综合情景、源任务和随机选择的任务所产生的核查证据。
我们使用双子座3.1 Flash-Lite 在两个基准上,并保持验证和推出预算的固定,只改变产生证据的任务。
根据这一预算,每种技能都通过5个综合情景、5个执行源任务或5个随机任务得到核实。
我们根据每种技能在被搁置任务上的有效性来评估核查的准确性,通过配对处决和不配对技术来衡量(附录B)。
技能如果能提高成功率,则被贴上有用标签;如果技能下降,则有害。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Verification with evidence from different types of tasks: held-out SR (bars, left axis) and F1 of the verdicts against held-out skill effects (line, right axis).
blocks.zh: 图3:用不同类型任务的证据进行核查:搁置的SR(栏,左轴)和针对搁置的技能效应(行,右轴)的判决的F1。

blocks.en:
Synthesized scenarios yield the highest verdict F1 and the best-performing skill library on both benchmarks (Figure 3 ), with held-out SR up to 15.7%p above the alternatives.
On ALFWorld, the verdicts from source and random tasks barely separate helpful from harmful skills, and the libraries they retain fall below No Skill, with random-task verification even below the unverified library.
Source tasks expose the skill-relevant situation only in its original context and random tasks rarely expose it at all, so neither provides the evidence that verification requires.
blocks.zh:
合成假想产生两个基准(图3)上最高的判定F1和表现最好的技能库,被搁置的SR最高高出替代品的15.7%p.
在ALFWorld上,来自源代码和随机任务的判决几乎与有害技能无关,它们保留的库都低于No Skill,随机任务验证甚至低于未经验证的库.
原始任务只在其原始背景中暴露出与技能有关的情况,而随机任务则很少暴露出来,因此两者都不提供核查所需的证据.

blocks.en: 5.2 RQ2: Does verification predict skill reusability?
blocks.zh: 5.2 RQ2:核查是否预测技能的可重复性?

blocks.en: Table 3: Verdict agreement with held-out skill effects.
blocks.zh: 表3:与技能效应有关的判决协议。

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports precision, recall, F1, and specificity of the verdicts on both benchmarks.
On WebShop, verification closely predicts the held-out utility of retained skills.
High precision and specificity indicate that verification reliably retains helpful skills on held-out tasks while filtering out harmful ones.
The 82.8% recall shows that verification preserves most helpful skills, although some are incorrectly rejected.
Thus, on WebShop, a Keep verdict provides a strong indication that the skill remians useful beyond its source experience.
blocks.zh:
表3报告关于这两个基准的判决的精确性、回顾性、F1和具体性。
在WebShop上,验证严密预测了保留技能的被搁置效用.
高度精确和具体表明,核查在排除有害任务的同时,可靠地保留了搁置任务的有用技能。
82.8%的召回率表明,核查保留了最有用的技能,但有些技能被错误地拒绝。
因此,在WebShop上,Keep判决有力地表明,这种技能在来源经验之外是有用的。

blocks.en:
Overall agreement is lower on ALFWorld, but verification still preserves the useful skills and improves the composition of the library.
Only 23.9% of the ALFWorld skills are helpful on held-out tasks, which lowers precision.
Verification nevertheless retains 81.8% of the helpful skills, nearly the same recall as on WebShop, and helpful skills make up 39.1% of the verified library, which is higher than the unverified library.
Verification thus selects a more useful subset from execution evidence even where helpful skills are scarce.
blocks.zh:
对ALFWorld的总体共识较低,但核查仍然保留了有用的技能并改进了图书馆的组成.
只有23.9%的ALFWorld技能帮助了被搁置的任务,这降低了精度.
尽管如此,核查保留了81.8%的有用技能,几乎与WebShop上的记录相同,有用技能占已核实图书馆的39.1%,高于未核实图书馆。
因此,即使在缺乏有用技能的情况下,核查也会从执行证据中挑选一个更有用的子集。

blocks.en: 5.3 RQ3: Does reliable skill verification require a stronger model?
blocks.zh: 5.3 RQ3: (中文(简体) ). 可靠的技能核查是否需要一个更强有力的模式?

blocks.en:
Our framework targets self-evolving agents, which the quality of verification must therefore not depend on the capability of the model.
To test this property, we replace only the Proposer with a stronger model (GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) ).
The two Proposer s in Table 3 share the skills, the executor, the Builder , and the Verifier .
Comparing their verdicts against the same held-out effects evaluates whether a stronger model is essential for reliable verification.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架针对的是自我演变的物剂,因此核查的质量不能取决于模型的能力。
为了测试这个属性,我们只用更强大的模型(GPT-5.6 Luna (OpenAI, 2026. ))来取而代之的是投标人.
表3中的两名投标人分享技能,
将它们的判决与同样的搁置效应相比较,可以评估更强有力的模式对可靠核查是否至关重要。

blocks.en:
On both benchmarks, the executor’s own model matches or exceeds GPT-5.6 Luna in every metric and retains more of the helpful skills.
The stronger Proposer is not more accurate, since it rejects more helpful skills but no more harmful ones.
Reliable verdicts therefore do not depend on the intuitive judgment that only a stronger model could provide.
This result follows from the division of scenario synthesis into planning and construction, since the LLM is used only for planning and rollouts, and construction and scoring are fixed procedures.
Structured execution evidence thus lowers the dependence of verification on model capability, and a self-evolving agent can select useful skills from its own execution evidence without an external model stronger than itself.
blocks.zh:
在这两个基准中,执行者自己的模型在每分标准中匹配或超过GPT-5.6 Luna,并保留更多有用的技能.
更强的投标人并不准确,因为它拒绝更有用的技能,但不再有害。
因此,可靠的判决并不取决于只有更强有力的模式才能提供的直观判断。
这一结果源于将情景综合分为规划和建筑,因为LLM只用于规划和推出,而建筑和打分是固定的程序.
结构化的执行证据因此降低了核查对模型能力的依赖性,自我演化的代理能够从自己的执行证据中选择有用的技能,而没有比自己更强大的外部模型.

blocks.en: 5.4 RQ4: What do the synthesized scenarios reveal about skill reusability?
blocks.zh: 5.4 问题4: 综合情景显示技能的可重复性是什么?

blocks.en: Figure 4: Executability, utility, and efficiency across all executors and benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图4:所有执行者和基准的可执行性、效用和效率。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 analyze the skills’ reusability according to three verification criterion executability, utility, and efficiency (Section 3.2 ) across all models.
Executability is the number of scenarios with at least one action assigned e = 1 e=1 , indicating that the action implements the skill’s principle .
Utility is the gain of the success rate between paired runs.
Efficiency compares remaining action counts from the skill-used step to termination.
In case of efficiency, we include only success pairs in both runs.
blocks.zh:
图4根据三种核查标准(第3.2节)对所有模型的可执行性、实用性和效率进行分析。
可执行性是指至少指定一个动作e=1个e=1的情景数,表示该动作执行技能原则. .
效用是成对跑道之间成功率的得分.
效率比较了从使用技能的步骤到终止的其余行动。
就效率而言,我们只把成功的对子列入这两个项目。

blocks.en:
On WebShop, agents take more actions on average with skills, even when both with and without-skill runs succeed.
For Qwen3.5-27B and Gemini, skills improve task success but also add inefficiency on tasks that succeed without them.
This indicates that since success gains alone are insufficient to assess skill reusability, verification must also account for the additional actions introduced by skill guidance.
On ALFWorld, both Qwen models instead gain in success and save actions, showing that skill guidance can also yield successful execution.
Gemini exhibits a different failure pattern.
Despite high executability, skill lowers success and increases action counts, exposing a limitation in the benefit of the guidance beyond whether it can be followed.
blocks.zh:
在WebShop上,代理商平均会用技能采取更多的动作,即使无论有还是无技能运行都成功.
对Quen3.5-27B和双子座来说,技能提高了任务的成功率,但也增加了没有这些成功的任务效率低下.
这表明,由于仅靠成功收益不足以评估技能的可重复性,核查还必须考虑到技能指导所带来的其他行动。
在ALFWorld上,Quen模型反而都获得了成功并节省了动作,表明技能指导也可以产生成功执行.
双子座显示出不同的失败模式.
尽管可执行性很高,但技能降低了成功率,增加了行动的重要性,暴露出除了是否可遵循指导之外,指导的惠益受到限制。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Agents acquire reusable skills by abstracting past executions into programs or workflows that can be retrieved and applied in subsequent tasks ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ) .
A complementary approach distills successful and failed experiences into textual insights, reasoning strategies, or procedural instructions that guide future decisions ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2026b ; Fang et al., 2026b ) .
Feedback-driven curation provides an implicit form of verification, using subsequent execution outcomes to revise stored guidance or learn policies for managing the skill repository ( Fang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ) .
More explicit verification evaluates the effects of individual skills through source-task tests or paired runs with and without the skill, informing refinement and retention decisions ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
However, these methods can leave skills insufficiently verified, as the verification evidence they provide are neither skill-relevant nor new.
We identify the lack of reliable opportunities to evaluate each skill as a central verification problem.
blocks.zh:
代理人通过将过去的被处决抽象为程序或工作流程,从而获得可重复使用的技能,这些程序或工作流程可以检索并应用于以后的任务(Wang等,2023;Wang等,2025b;Wang等,2025a).
补充方法将成功和失败的经验提炼成指导未来决定的文字见解、推理战略或程序指示(赵等,2024;欧阳等,2026b;方等,2026b.).
反馈驱动的校正提供了一种隐含的核查形式,利用后续执行结果修订存储的指南或学习管理技能库的政策(Fang等人,2026b; 张等,2026;欧阳等,2026a.
更明确的核查通过源头任务测试或与技能相配和不与技能相配评估个人技能的影响,为完善和保留决定提供信息(Wang等人,2025a; Ma等, 2026 (英语).
然而,这些方法可能使技能得不到充分的核实,因为它们提供的核查证据既不与技能相关,也不新鲜。
我们认为,缺乏评估每种技能的可靠机会是一个核心核查问题。

blocks.en:
Recent approaches synthesize tasks and environments to train LLM agents.
Task generation expands training opportunities within available environments ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
Environment synthesis constructs the interaction setting itself through executable environments or LLM-based simulators ( Chae et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026a ; Song et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) .
Adaptive approaches use the learner’s performance to guide generation toward suitable difficulty levels or weaknesses in the current policy ( Dennis et al., 2020 ; Zala et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .
However, these objectives are insufficient for skill verification on their own, as they do not ensure that execution encounters the situation that the skill targets.
To address the challenges in skill verification, we propose a framework that dynamically synthesizes tasks and environment for each target skill at verification time.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法综合了任务和环境来训练LLM代理.
任务生成在现有环境中扩大培训机会 (周等,2025;孙等,2025;齐等,2025;周等,2026.
环境合成通过可执行环境或基于LLM的模拟器构建互动环境本身(Chae等人,2026;Fang等人,2026a; Song等, 2026; Chen等, 2026b.).
适应性方法利用学习者的表现引导一代人进入当前政策的适当难度或弱点(Dennis等,2020年;Zala等,2024年;Guo等,2025年)。
然而,这些目标本身不足以进行技能核查,因为它们无法确保执行会遇到技能目标的情况。
为了应对技能核查方面的挑战,我们提出了一个框架,在核查时动态综合每种目标技能的任务和环境。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce SkillSandbox , a framework that verifies skill reusability by dynamically synthesizing tasks and environments that reproduce each skill’s applicable conditions in contexts beyond its source experience.
The framework verifies each skill by having the agent solve the synthesized tasks in the synthesized environments, testing whether its guidance remains useful in these new situations.
Across ALFWorld and WebShop, the verified libraries achieve the highest success rate and efficiency compared to other methods.
Further analyses show that synthesized scenarios improve the quality of verification, and that effective verification is possible using the executor’s own model.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了SkillSandbox, 这个框架通过动态合成任务和环境来验证技能的可重复性,
框架通过使代理人在被合成的环境中解决被合成的任务,测试其指导在这些新情况中是否仍然有用来验证每种技能.
在整个ALFWorld和WebShop,经过验证的库相比其他方法取得了最高的成功率和效率.
进一步的分析表明,综合设想方案提高了核查的质量,而且使用执行人自己的模式可以进行有效核查。

blocks.en: Appendix A Baseline Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 基线细节

blocks.en:
We distinguish no verification (unconditionally retaining generated skills) from execution-based verification , which includes feedback-driven skill admission, revision, removal, or reweighting.
The latter uses either source replay (repeated attempts at the original task) or downstream tasks (subsequent source tasks selected independently of a skill).
All libraries are built from the same 100 source tasks and frozen before held-out evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们把任何核查(无条件保留生成的技能)与基于执行的核查区分开来,后者包括反馈驱动的技能录取、修订、去除或重新加权。
后者要么使用源重放(在原始任务上重复尝试),要么使用下游任务(随后独立于技能选择的源任务).
所有图书馆都是从同样的100个源任务建造的,在被搁置评价前被冻结.

blocks.en:
No verification. Each source trajectory is distilled into an applicability condition and an actionable principle using the skill distillation prompts in Appendix .
All generated skills are retained; SkillSandbox verifies skills from this same initial pool.
blocks.zh:
没有核实。 利用附录中的技术蒸馏提示,将每个源道蒸馏成适用条件和可操作原则。
所有生成的技能都保留下来; SkillSandbox从同一个初始库中验证技能.

blocks.en:
No verification. ReasoningBank sequentially solves source tasks using prior memories, judges each outcome, and extracts up to three structured memories from each trajectory.
Our basic variant, without MaTTS, appends all extracted items without revising or deleting existing ones: the judge assesses task success, not memory utility.
blocks.zh:
没有核实。 理性银行利用先前的记忆相继地解决源任务,判断每个结果,从每个轨迹取出最多三个结构化的记忆.
我们的基本变体,没有 MaTTS, 附加所有提取的项目而不修改或删除已有的项目: 法官评估任务成功与否, 而不是内存工具 。

blocks.en:
No verification. We use MemP’s Script representation with Vanilla updates.
The executor sequentially solves source tasks using retrieved scripts; after each task, a builder appends one workflow summary regardless of success, without utility-based filtering, revision, or deletion.
blocks.zh:
没有核实。 我们使用MemP的脚本代表,
执行器使用被检索到的脚本相继地解决源任务;在每次任务结束后,一个构建器会附加一个工作流程摘要而不管成功与否,没有基于工具的过滤,修订,或删除.

blocks.en:
Execution-based verification: source replay. ExpeL collects source trajectories before extracting insights.
After failure, our executor reflects and retries the same task at most once.
Using the same model, the extractor compares successful and failed attempts and groups of successes, curating rules through ADD , EDIT , AGREE , and REMOVE with importance counters.
blocks.zh:
基于执行的验证:源重放. ExpeL在取出真知灼见之前收集出出源轨迹.
失败后,我们的执行者最多一次反映并重复同一任务.
提取器使用相同的模型,将成功和失败的尝试和成功组合进行比较,通过ADD,EDIT,AGREE,和REMOVE等重要计数器来规范规则.

blocks.en:
Execution-based verification: downstream tasks. ACE solves tasks with an evolving playbook, reflects on entry helpfulness, and incrementally curates the playbook.
Our implementation makes three source passes, adding entries and updating feedback counters, with separate duplicate merging and budget-triggered pruning of harmful entries.
Held-out evaluation uses the entire frozen playbook rather than top-three retrieval.
blocks.zh:
基于执行的核查:下游任务。 ACE用不断发展的游戏本解决任务,反思入场帮助,并逐渐地整理出游戏本.
我们的执行使三个来源通过,增加条目并更新反馈计数器,对有害条目进行单独的重复合并和从预算上抽取。
Hold-out评价使用整个被冻结的游戏本而不是前三回取.

blocks.en:
Execution-based verification: downstream tasks. We use training-free SkillOS-base ( Ouyang et al., 2026a ) , with the paper’s Appendix A prompts.
The executor makes one ordered source pass, retrieving skills from the evolving repository with BM25.
After each task, the curator uses its trajectory, outcome, and retrieved skills to insert, update, or delete skills before the next task.
blocks.zh:
基于执行的核查:下游任务。 我们使用免费的SkillOS基地(Oyang等,2026a),
执行器使一个命令源通过,用BM25从正在演变的寄存器取回技能.
每次任务完成后,管理员会利用其轨迹,结果,并检索技能来插入,更新,或删除下个任务之前的技能.

blocks.zh: 附录B 细节

We distill each source trajectory into an applicability condition and an actionable principle (Appendix ).
On both benchmarks, held-out retrieval ranks full skill texts against the task query by cosine similarity using text-embedding-3-small , supplying the top three skills in descending order.

我们把每个源的轨迹都提炼成适用性条件和可操作原则(附录)。
在这两个基准上,被搁置的检索将全部技能文本与任务查询进行排序,通过使用文本嵌入-3-小的同位素相类似,按降序提供前三名技能。

blocks.en:
For Question I (Section 2 ), GPT-5.6 Luna extracts fixed conditions from When to apply , consulting Principle for context, then checks them against the task objective and with-skill trajectory. Observed requires evidence for all conditions and their logical and temporal relationships; state and history conditions require trajectory evidence, not task outcomes or claimed skill use.
Otherwise, the label is Not Observed .
We report the mean number of Observed tasks per skill across 50 skills, each evaluated on 10 retrieved tasks.
blocks.zh:
对于问题一(第2节),GPT-5.6月从何时适用中提取固定条件,参考上下文原则,然后对照任务目标和技能轨迹加以检查。 观察需要所有条件及其逻辑和时间关系的证据;状态和历史条件需要轨迹证据,而不是任务结果或声称的技能使用。
否则,
我们报告50个技能中每个技能的观察任务的平均数目,每个技能对10个检索任务进行评价。

blocks.en:
For Question II, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite executes a fixed random stream of 500 held-out WebShop tasks using the same 50-skill library, with three repeats per setting: Full Library, Top-3, and Top-5 Retrieval.
Retrieval uses the embedding method above.
The ReAct executor cites skill identifiers when using them; at each stream prefix, we report the percentage of skills cited in at least one or five distinct tasks.
blocks.zh:
对于"问题二",双子座 3.1 Flash-Lite使用相同的50个技能库执行由500个被搁置出WebShop任务组成的固定随机流,每个设置有三个重复:Full Library,Top-3和Top-5检索.
检索使用上方的嵌入法.
ReAct执行器在使用时引用技能标识符;在每个流前缀,我们报告至少一个或五个不同任务中引用的技能百分比.

blocks.en:
The Verifier compares trajectories τ + \tau^{+} and τ − \tau^{-} produced by the same executor in the same synthesized scenario, with and without skill k k , respectively.
We align the full trajectories by maximizing the number of pairs with identical pre-action observations, preserving temporal order and using each step at most once.
Ties are resolved by choosing the lexicographically earliest sequence of paired step indices, with the τ + \tau^{+} index first.
For each distinct observation, we retain only the earliest aligned pair whose step in τ + \tau^{+} is marked as using skill k k .
From the same observation, we examine how using the skill changes the agent’s subsequent behavior compared with execution without the skill.

blocks.zh: 附录C 综合

blocks.en:
The synthesis typology of Section 5.4 covers scenarios generated for WebShop and ALFWorld skills in the Qwen3.5-27B setting.
For each environment, GPT-5.6 Luna first summarizes each scenario’s operations and implementation plan in one or two sentences and induces types from these summaries.
To categorize how skills cause harm, we select the scenarios, in which the executor fails with the skill, succeeds without it, and receives a negative scenario score.
Given the skill, both trajectories, and their outcomes, the same model explains how the skill could have contributed to the failure, and the explanations are grouped into types in the same way.
blocks.zh:
第5.4节的综合类型涵盖为WebShop和ALFWorld技能在Quen3.5-27B环境下生成的情景。
对于每一种环境,GPT-5.6 Luna首先用一到两句来总结每个情景的操作和执行计划,并从这些摘要中引出类型.
为了对技能如何造成伤害进行分类,我们选择了各种情景,其中执行者在技能上失败,没有技能就成功,并获得负情景分数.
鉴于技能,既有轨迹,也有其成果,同一种模式解释了技能如何能够促成失败,解释也以同样的方式被归为类型.
